- `IdempotencyStore` (protocol: claim, complete, release, update): Atomic per-key leases and replay entries shared by every worker of a service.
- `MemoryEventStream(*, max_events_per_run: int = 1000, max_runs: int = 1000) -> None`: In-memory `EventStream`: the last `max_events_per_run` events of the last `max_runs` runs.
- `MemoryIdempotencyStore(*, max_entries: int = 10000, clock: Callable[[], float] = monotonic) -> None`: In-process `IdempotencyStore` (one worker); oldest replay entries go first past `max_entries`, leases are never evicted.
- `PROBLEM_MEDIA_TYPE = 'application/problem+json'`
- `Principal(id: str, scopes: frozenset[str] = frozenset(), claims: Mapping[str, Any] = <factory>) -> None`: An authenticated caller; `id` scopes every run, call and approval it touches.
- `Problem(*, type: str, title: str, status: int, detail: str = '', **extra_data: Any) -> None`: An RFC 9457 problem; extensions (`tool`, `errors`, `approval_id`, ...) are extra fields.
- `Readiness(*, needs_lifespan: bool) -> None`: The `/readyz` state of one `create_app` app, found at `app.state.readiness`.
- `RedisIdempotencyStore(client_factory: Callable[[], Any], *, prefix: str = '') -> None`: `IdempotencyStore` on Redis (`agent-adapter[redis]`), shared by every worker.
- `RequestInfo(method: str, path: str, headers: Mapping[str, str], query: Mapping[str, str], client: str | None) -> None`: A framework-neutral view of one HTTP request (header names in any case).
- `ServiceResponse(status: int, body: Any = None, media_type: str = 'application/json', headers: Mapping[str, str] = <factory>, stream: AsyncIterator[bytes] | None = None) -> None`: A framework-neutral response: JSON `body`, or an SSE `stream` of bytes.
- `Stored(fingerprint: str, status: int, body: Any, media_type: str = 'application/json', headers: Mapping[str, str] = <factory>) -> None`: A response kept for replay, with the fingerprint of the request that produced it.
- `ToolService(registry: Registry, *, executor: Executor | None = None, approvals: ApprovalStore | None = None, events: EventStream | None = None, ledger: LedgerPort | None = None, idempotency: IdempotencyStore | CachePort | None = None, authenticate: Authenticator | None = None, authorize: Authorizer | None = None, authorize_decision: DecisionAuthorizer | None = None, allow_anonymous: bool = False, idempotency_ttl: float = 86400, title: str = 'agent-adapter tools') -> None`: The HTTP tool server's behaviour behind `handle(request, body)`.
- `bearer_auth(tokens: Mapping[str, Principal] | TokenVerifier) -> Authenticator`: An authenticator for `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- `create_app(registry: Registry, *, mcp: bool = True, mcp_path: str = '/mcp', prefix: str = '', **service_options: Any) -> Any`: A Starlette app for `ToolService(registry, **service_options)`; MCP at `prefix + mcp_path`.
- `create_wsgi_app(registry: Registry, **options: Any) -> WsgiApp`: `a2wsgi.ASGIMiddleware(create_app(registry, **options))` with the app's lifespan running.
- `is_invoker(principal: Principal, record: ApprovalRecord) -> bool`: True when `principal` made the call `record` waits on (from the record's metadata).
- `openapi_document(registry: Registry, *, title: str, version: str, server_url: str | None = None, dialect: Dialect = '3.1') -> dict[str, Any]`: OpenAPI for the tools of `registry` exported to `http` and every server route.
- `problem_for(exc: BaseException) -> Problem`: The problem for an exception: `detail` is `ErrorInfo.message` (the class name only for exceptions that are not `AdapterError`), plus `tool`, `errors`, `approval_id`.
- `serve(app: Any, *, host: str = '127.0.0.1', port: int = 8000) -> None`: Run `app` with uvicorn (blocking); a `create_app` app learns its real bind host.
- `set_log_key(key: bytes) -> None`: Share the `principal_ref` key between workers so their logs correlate (>= 16 bytes).

### `agent_adapter.tracing`

Tracing: the event catalogue, event sinks and the OpenTelemetry sink.

- `CallbackEventSink(fn: Callable[[Event], None]) -> None`: Calls `fn(event)`; a failing callback is logged, never raised.
- `EventLog(*, max_events: int = 10000) -> None`: Keeps the latest `max_events` events in memory, oldest dropped first.
- `EventSink` (protocol: emit): Receives trace events; `emit` is sync, non-blocking and never raises.
- `EventType()`: Event type strings; anything else must start with `custom.`.
- `FanoutSink(*sinks: EventSink) -> None`: Sends each event to every sink in order; a failing sink does not stop the others.
- `LoggingSink(logger: Logger | None = None, *, level: int = 10, capture_content: bool = False) -> None`: Logs each event at `level`; content keys only with `capture_content` and at DEBUG.
- `OTelSink(*, tracer_provider: Any | None = None, meter_provider: Any | None = None, capture_content: bool = False, instrumentation_name: str = 'agent_adapter') -> None`: An `EventSink` exporting GenAI-convention spans and metrics (needs opentelemetry-api).
- `REQUIRED_DATA`: `dict` instance
- `SinkHub(base: EventSink | None = None, extra: tuple[EventSink, ...] = ()) -> None`: An executor's stable sink: `base` (the constructor's sink), then every added sink.
- `emit(sink: EventSink | None, event: Event) -> None`: Send `event` to `sink`; a no-op for None.
- `make_event(type: str, ctx: ToolContext | None = None, *, call_id: str | None = None, **data: Any) -> Event`: An event with ids from `ctx`; an explicit `call_id` makes `ctx.call_id` the parent.

### `agent_adapter.viewer`

Run viewer: record runs to JSONL files, browse them and chat locally (`agent-adapter ui`).

- `ApprovalDesk(path: str | PathLike[str], reviewer: str) -> None`: Decides tool approvals in a `SQLiteApprovalStore` file; it never runs a tool.
- `Attachment(name: str, media_type: str, size: int, path: Path, id: str = '') -> None`: A file the user attached; `path` is a local copy the server stored.
- `ChatAgent` (protocol): `agent(message, session)`: async or sync; returns text or an async iterator of chunks.
- `ChatMessage(text: str, attachments: tuple[Attachment, ...] = ()) -> None`: The user's message of one turn.
- `ChatSession(id: str, history: tuple[Message, ...], state: dict[str, Any], executor: Executor, run_id: str) -> None`: One conversation as the agent sees it during a turn; `state` is live and mutable.
- `DEFAULT_FOLDER = '.agent_adapter/runs'`
- `LOOPBACK = '127.0.0.1'`
- `Recorder(folder: str | PathLike[str] = '.agent_adapter/runs', *, capture_content: bool = False, keep_runs: int = 200, max_events_per_run: int = 50000, max_queue: int = 10000, registry: RegistrySource = None, source: str = '') -> None`: Writes events under `folder`, one segment file per run and process (append-only).
- `RunFolder(target: str | Path) -> None`: A runs folder, or a single run file, read again on each `refresh` from where it stopped.
- `ViewerServer(folder: RunFolder, desk: ApprovalDesk | None, port: int, chat: ChatHost | None = None) -> None`: A ThreadingHTTPServer holding the runs folder, the approval desk and its secrets.
- `assign_lanes(spans: Iterable[dict[str, Any]]) -> int`: Give each span the lowest free lane at its start (greedy interval colouring).
- `build_spans(events: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]`: One span per call (tool, LLM, node, flow, compression), in start order, with lanes.
- `check_host(host: str) -> None`: Refuse any bind address but the IPv4 loopback.
- `export(target: str | Path, out: str | Path, *, run: str | None = None) -> Path`: Write the runs under `target` (or only `run`) into the HTML file `out`; return its path.
- `layout(graph: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]`: A copy of `graph`: nodes get `layer`, `order` and `x`; edges get `via` (bend x per layer).
- `make_server(target: str | Path, *, host: str = '127.0.0.1', port: int = 8780, approvals: str | Path | None = None, reviewer: str = '', chat: ChatHost | None = None) -> ViewerServer`: A bound, not yet serving, viewer server (`port=0` picks a free port); `chat` turns chat on.
- `record(executor: Executor | None = None, *, folder: str | PathLike[str] = '.agent_adapter/runs', capture_content: bool = False, keep_runs: int = 200, source: str = '') -> Recorder`: Record every run of `executor` under `folder`.
- `serve(agent: ChatAgent | None = None, *, model: LLMPort | None = None, registry: Registry | None = None, executor: Executor | None = None, folder: str | PathLike[str] = '.agent_adapter/runs', port: int = 8780, open_browser: bool = True, system: str = '', max_steps: int = 8, turn_timeout: float = 300.0, approval_timeout: float = 600.0, reviewer: str = 'local', chat_dir: str | PathLike[str] = '.agent_adapter/chats', stream: bool = True, out: TextIO | None = None) -> None`: Chat with `agent` (or the built-in loop over `model` and `registry`) in the viewer.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.a2a`

A2A: serve registry tools as an A2A agent, and import a remote agent's skills as tools.

- `A2AConnection(card: AgentCard, client: Client, http: Any) -> None`: An open A2A client, the agent card it was built from, and its HTTP client.
- `A2AIntegration()`: Exports one `AgentSkill` per tool; `a2a_app` / `a2a_executor` run the calls.
- `CARD_PATH = '/.well-known/agent-card.json'`
- `Caller(id: str, scopes: frozenset[str] = <factory>) -> None`: A minimal principal: `id` scopes tasks, runs and approvals (`""` is anonymous).
- `HostRefused` (error): An outbound A2A request to a host the guard does not allow.
- `INTEGRATION`: `A2AIntegration` instance
- `PRINCIPAL_STATE = 'aa.a2a.principal'`
- `ResponseTooLarge` (error): A remote A2A response over the byte limit.
- `TOOLS_EXTENSION = 'urn:agent-adapter:a2a:tools:v1'`
- `ToolAgent(registry: Registry, executor: ToolRunner | None = None, *, client_approval: bool = False, authorize: Authorizer | None = None, max_data_bytes: int = 262144) -> None`: Reads a `{tool, arguments}` data part, runs it, and reports through `TaskUpdater`.
- `a2a_app(registry: Registry, *, url: str, executor: ToolRunner | None = None, authenticate: Authenticator | None = None, authorize: Authorizer | None = None, allow_anonymous: bool = False, host: str = '127.0.0.1', allowed_hosts: Iterable[str] | None = None, public_card: bool = False, client_approval: bool = False, name: str = 'agent-adapter', description: str = 'Tools served by agent-adapter.', version: str = '1.0.0', max_body_bytes: int = 1048576, max_data_bytes: int = 262144, task_store: Any = None) -> Any`: A Starlette app: the agent card at `CARD_PATH`, JSON-RPC A2A at `/`.
- `a2a_executor(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None, client_approval: bool = False, authorize: Authorizer | None = None, max_data_bytes: int = 262144) -> AgentExecutor`: An `a2a-sdk` `AgentExecutor` running `registry.for_target("a2a")` tools.
- `agent_card(registry: Registry, *, url: str, name: str = 'agent-adapter', description: str = 'Tools served by agent-adapter.', version: str = '1.0.0') -> AgentCard`: An AgentCard for `registry.for_target("a2a")`, served at `url` over JSON-RPC.
- `agent_skill(spec: ToolSpec) -> AgentSkill`: The skill for one tool: id and name are the tool name.
- `bounded_task_store(*, ttl: float = 86400.0, max_tasks: int = 10000, max_per_owner: int = 1000, clock: Callable[[], float] = monotonic) -> Any`: An SDK `TaskStore` in memory: tasks expire `ttl` s after their last update.
- `async call_remote(connection: A2AConnection, skill_id: str, parts: list[Any], *, timeout_s: float = 300.0, poll_interval_s: float = 1.0) -> Any`: Send one message, poll its task to a final or interrupted state, return its result.
- `async connect_a2a(url: str, *, headers: Mapping[str, str] | None = None, auth: Any = None, allow_private: bool = False, trusted_hosts: Iterable[str] = (), allow_cross_origin: bool = False, timeout_s: float = 30.0, max_response_bytes: int = 4194304, http_transport: Any = None) -> A2AConnection`: Fetch the agent card at `url` + `CARD_PATH` and open a non-streaming A2A client.
- `async import_a2a(registry: Registry, connection: A2AConnection, *, prefix: str = '', names: Iterable[str] | None = None, task_timeout_s: float = 300.0, poll_interval_s: float = 1.0, **policy: Any) -> list[ToolSpec]`: Register one tool per remote skill (all, or the skill ids in `names`).
- `static_bearer(tokens: Mapping[str, str]) -> Authenticator`: An authenticator for `Authorization: Bearer <token>` over a `{token: caller id}` table.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.adk`

Google ADK 2.x: tools as `BaseTool`s with a confirmation bridge, flows as a `Workflow`.

- `AdkIntegration()`: Exports `BaseTool`s and compiles flows to ADK `Workflow`s.
- `INTEGRATION`: `AdkIntegration` instance
- `TARGET = 'adk'`
- `adk_tool(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> Any`: An ADK `BaseTool` running `spec` through the executor; `confirm` gates via ADK.
- `adk_tools(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> list[Any]`: An ADK `BaseTool` for every registry tool exported to `adk`.
- `bind_context(tool_context: Any) -> ToolContext`: Our context for an ADK `ToolContext` (run = invocation id, call = function call id).
- `compile_flow(flow: Flow[Any], *, executor: Executor | None = None, name: str | None = None, max_steps: int = 100, model: LLMPort | None = None) -> Any`: `flow` as an ADK `Workflow` (`START -> aa_driver`); run it with `run_workflow`.
- `async resolve_confirmations(events: Iterable[Any], port: ApprovalPort, registry: Registry) -> Any`: The user `Content` answering every open tool confirmation in `events`, from `port`.
- `resume_message(interrupt_id: str, decision: ApprovalDecision) -> Any`: The user `types.Content` answering one interrupt with `decision`.
- `async run_workflow(workflow: Any, state: Any, *, session_service: Any = None, user_id: str = 'user') -> FlowResult[Any]`: Run a `compile_flow` Workflow from `state`, or continue it with a `resume_message`.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.ag2`

AG2 (the `ag2` package): each ToolSpec as a `FunctionTool`; approval as tool middleware.

- `AG2Integration()`: Exports `FunctionTool`s; `bind_approval` gives no gate (use `ag2_tool(approval=)`).
- `INTEGRATION`: `AG2Integration` instance
- `ag2_compress_policy(policy: CompressionPolicy, *, pinned: Pinned | None = None, model_max_tokens: int | None = None) -> CompressAssemblyPolicy`: An assembly policy for `Agent(..., assembly=[ag2_compress_policy(policy)])`.
- `ag2_tool(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None, approval: ApprovalPort | None = None, middleware: Iterable[Any] = ()) -> Any`: An AG2 `FunctionTool` for `spec`.
- `ag2_tools(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None, approval: ApprovalPort | None = None, middleware: Iterable[Any] = ()) -> list[Any]`: AG2 `FunctionTool`s for every registry tool exported to this target.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.ag_ui`

AG-UI 1.0: stream runs as AG-UI events; approvals become interrupts, resumes ask the port.

- `AGUIBridge(executor: Executor, *, port: ApprovalPort | None = None, interrupts: InterruptTable | None = None, max_events: int = 10000, trace: bool = True) -> None`: Streams AG-UI runs of agent functions over one executor; holds the open interrupts.
- `AGUIInputInvalid` (error): A `RunAgentInput` that is not valid JSON, fails the schema, or exceeds a bound.
- `AGUIIntegration()`: Describes registry tools as AG-UI `Tool`s; runs and approvals go through `AGUIBridge`.
- `AGUIRun(run_input: RunAgentInput, *, executor: Executor, principal: str = '', max_events: int = 10000, trace: bool = True) -> None`: One AG-UI run: its input, an executor and context bound to its event stream.
- `Agent = Callable[[AGUIRun], Awaitable[Any]]`
- `Authenticate = Callable[[Any], Awaitable[str | None]]`
- `INTEGRATION`: `AGUIIntegration` instance
- `InterruptTable(*, ttl: float = 900.0, max_interrupts: int = 1024, max_per_principal: int = 64, clock: Callable[[], float] = monotonic, wall: Callable[[], float] = time) -> None`: The bridge's open interrupts, each answerable once, within its TTL, by its owner.
- `PendingCall(interrupt_id: str, thread_id: str, principal: str, run_id: str, call_id: str, tool: str, arguments: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, approval_id: str = '', expires_at: float = 0.0) -> None`: One paused tool call, bound to its thread, the principal who started it and our run.
- `TARGET = 'ag_ui'`
- `agui_endpoint(bridge: AGUIBridge, agent: Agent, *, authenticate: Authenticate, max_body_bytes: int = 1048576, allowed_hosts: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> Callable[[Any], Awaitable[Any]]`: A Starlette endpoint: authenticate, read a bounded JSON body, stream the run as SSE.
- `async anonymous(request: Any) -> str`: An `Authenticate` that lets everyone in as one anonymous principal (local use only).
- `parse_input(body: bytes | str | Mapping[str, Any] | RunAgentInput, *, max_bytes: int = 1048576) -> RunAgentInput`: A validated, bounded `RunAgentInput` from a request body or a parsed mapping.
- `to_messages(run_input: RunAgentInput) -> list[Message]`: The input's conversation as adapter `Message`s; text parts only, other roles skipped.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.agent_framework`

Microsoft Agent Framework: ToolSpecs as `FunctionTool`s, approval, a compression format.

- `AgentFrameworkIntegration()`: Exports `FunctionTool`s; MAF's function loop pauses `confirm` tools for approval.
- `INTEGRATION`: `AgentFrameworkIntegration` instance
- `agent_framework_tool(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> Any`: A `FunctionTool` for `spec`; any `confirm` rule sets `approval_mode="always_require"`.
- `agent_framework_tools(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> list[Any]`: `FunctionTool`s for every registry tool exported to this target.
- `async resolve_approvals(response: Any, port: ApprovalPort, registry: Registry, *, session: Any = None) -> list[Any]`: Answer each `function_approval_request` of `response` from `port`, in order.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.agno`

Agno: each ToolSpec as a `Function`; approval through `requires_confirmation`.

- `AgnoIntegration()`: Exports `Function`s; an Agno agent pauses `confirm` tools until they are resolved.
- `INTEGRATION`: `AgnoIntegration` instance
- `agno_compressed_model(model: Any, policy: CompressionPolicy, *, pinned: Pinned | None = None, model_max_tokens: int | None = None) -> Any`: A copy of an Agno model that compresses the messages of each provider call.
- `agno_function(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> Any`: An Agno `Function` for `spec`; any `confirm` rule sets `requires_confirmation`.
- `agno_functions(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> list[Any]`: Agno `Function`s for every registry tool exported to this target.
- `async resolve_requirements(output: Any, port: ApprovalPort, registry: Registry) -> None`: Confirm or reject each confirmation `output` paused on, from `port`.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.anthropic`

Render tools for the Anthropic Messages API as plain dicts.

- `AnthropicIntegration()`: Exports Messages API tool dicts; the host runs the model's `tool_use` blocks.
- `INTEGRATION`: `AnthropicIntegration` instance
- `anthropic_tool(spec: ToolSpec) -> dict[str, Any]`: One tool in Anthropic Messages format.
- `anthropic_tools(registry: Registry) -> list[dict[str, Any]]`: Every registry tool exported to Anthropic, in Messages format.
- `tool_result_blocks(results: Sequence[ToolResult]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]`: `tool_result` content blocks answering the model's `tool_use` blocks, in order.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.autogen`

AutoGen 0.7: registry tools as `BaseTool` subclasses that run through the executor.

- `AutoGenCall(call_id: str, cancellation_token: Any, tool: Any = None) -> None`: One AutoGen tool call, as `ctx.extras["autogen"]` holds it.
- `AutoGenIntegration()`: Exports `BaseTool`s; AutoGen has no per-tool approval gate, so the executor's port decides.
- `INTEGRATION`: `AutoGenIntegration` instance
- `autogen_model_context(policy: CompressionPolicy, *, initial_messages: Sequence[Any] | None = None, pinned: Pinned | None = None, model_max_tokens: int | None = None) -> Any`: A `ChatCompletionContext` that keeps every message and returns them compressed.
- `autogen_tool(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> Any`: One `autogen_core.tools.BaseTool` for `spec`.
- `autogen_tools(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> list[Any]`: A `BaseTool` for every registry tool exported to AutoGen.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.base`

The integration protocol: what every framework bridge provides, and a helper base class.

- `FlowCompiler` (protocol: compile_flow): An integration that also compiles flows; `flow` is a `FlowSpec` (typed Any here).
- `Integration` (protocol: bind_approval, bind_context, export_tool, extra, name, requires): A framework bridge; `name` is the canonical target name and the entry-point name.
- `IntegrationBase()`: Helper base for built-in and third-party integrations; subclasses add `export_tool`.
- `MODEL_VISIBLE_ERRORS = ...`
- `ToolRunner` (protocol: run_spec): Runs one tool call through the full policy pipeline (an `Executor` is one).
- `model_visible_error(exc: BaseException) -> dict[str, Any]`: `{"error": {"kind", "message"}}` for a tool result; foreign errors show only their type.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.camel`

CAMEL-AI: ToolSpecs as `FunctionTool`s (the executor's port approves), a compression format.

- `CamelIntegration()`: Exports `FunctionTool`s; `confirm` tools are decided by the executor's port.
- `INTEGRATION`: `CamelIntegration` instance
- `camel_tool(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None, strict: bool = True) -> Any`: A CAMEL `FunctionTool` for `spec`, with the OpenAI-transformed schema.
- `camel_tools(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None, strict: bool = True) -> list[Any]`: CAMEL `FunctionTool`s for every registry tool exported to this target.
- `openai_tool_schema(spec: ToolSpec, *, strict: bool = True) -> dict[str, Any]`: The Chat Completions tool schema CAMEL sends to the model for `spec`.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.claude_agent`

Claude Agent SDK: tools on an in-process SDK MCP server; approval through `can_use_tool`.

- `ClaudeAgentIntegration()`: Exports SDK MCP tools; a bridge's `can_use_tool` asks an approval port for Claude.
- `ClaudeSdkBridge(name: str, server: dict[str, Any], can_use_tool: CanUseTool, run_id: str, hooks: dict[str, list[Any]]) -> None`: An SDK MCP server, the `can_use_tool` gate its tools trust, and the gate's hooks.
- `INTEGRATION`: `ClaudeAgentIntegration` instance
- `can_use_tool(port: ApprovalPort, registry: Registry, *, server: str = 'agent_adapter') -> CanUseTool`: A permission-only `can_use_tool`: it grants no tokens, so a `confirm` tool is asked again by the executor's port when it runs (use `claude_sdk_bridge` to ask once).
- `claude_sdk_bridge(registry: Registry, port: ApprovalPort, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None, name: str = 'agent_adapter') -> ClaudeSdkBridge`: A server named `name` with its gate, for one client session: `ClaudeAgentOptions( mcp_servers={bridge.name: bridge.server}, can_use_tool=bridge.can_use_tool, hooks=bridge.hooks)`.
- `claude_sdk_server(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None, name: str = 'agent_adapter') -> dict[str, Any]`: An SDK MCP server config without a gate (see `claude_sdk_bridge` for approvals).
- `claude_sdk_tool(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> Any`: An `SdkMcpTool` for `spec`; a `confirm` tool is approved by the executor's own port.
- `claude_sdk_tools(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> list[Any]`: `SdkMcpTool`s for every registry tool exported to this target.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.crewai`

CrewAI: registry tools as `BaseTool`s; `_run` bridges to the executor with `run_sync`.

- `CrewAIIntegration()`: Exports `BaseTool`s; CrewAI has no call id at the tool boundary.
- `INTEGRATION`: `CrewAIIntegration` instance
- `crewai_tool(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> BaseTool`: A `BaseTool` with `args_schema=spec.args_model`: `_arun` is async, `_run` uses `run_sync`.
- `crewai_tools(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> list[BaseTool]`: `crewai_tool` for every registry tool exported to `crewai`.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.discovery`

Find integrations through the `agent_adapter.integrations` entry-point group.

- `GROUP = 'agent_adapter.integrations'`
- `available_integrations(*, refresh: bool = False) -> dict[str, Integration]`: Every integration that loads and conforms, by name; cached until `refresh=True`.
- `get_integration(name: str) -> Integration`: The integration registered as `name`, with its required modules importable.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.dspy`

DSPy: registry tools as `dspy.Tool`s that run through the executor.

- `DSPyIntegration()`: Exports `dspy.Tool`s; DSPy has no approval gate, so the executor's port decides.
- `INTEGRATION`: `DSPyIntegration` instance
- `dspy_tool(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> Any`: One `dspy.Tool` for `spec`; `acall` is native, sync `__call__` goes through `run_sync`.
- `dspy_tools(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> list[Any]`: A `dspy.Tool` for every registry tool exported to DSPy.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.gemini`

Gemini: function declarations, genai automatic-function-calling proxies, call dispatch.

- `GeminiIntegration()`: Exports function declaration dicts; the host runs the calls (`run_function_calls`).
- `INTEGRATION`: `GeminiIntegration` instance
- `afc_callable(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> Callable[..., Awaitable[Any]]`: An async function for genai's `GenerateContentConfig(tools=[...])` that runs `spec`.
- `afc_callables(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> list[Callable[..., Awaitable[Any]]]`: `afc_callable` for every registry tool exported to Gemini.
- `function_declaration(spec: ToolSpec) -> dict[str, Any]`: One tool as a Gemini function declaration dict.
- `function_declarations(registry: Registry) -> list[dict[str, Any]]`: Every registry tool exported to Gemini, as function declaration dicts.
- `genai_tool(registry: Registry) -> Any`: A `google.genai.types.Tool` holding every registry tool exported to Gemini.
- `async run_function_calls(calls: Iterable[Any], *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None, ctx: ToolContext | None = None, registry: Registry | None = None) -> list[Any]`: Run the model's function calls; one function-response `types.Part` per call, in order.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.haystack`

Haystack: each ToolSpec as a `Tool`; approval through a `before_tool` confirmation hook.

- `HaystackIntegration()`: Exports Haystack `Tool`s; `confirmation_hook` asks an approval port before calls.
- `INTEGRATION`: `HaystackIntegration` instance
- `confirmation_hook(port: ApprovalPort, registry: Registry) -> Any`: A `before_tool` Agent hook: asks `port` about `registry` tools whose rule says so.
- `haystack_tool(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> Any`: A Haystack `Tool` for `spec` with both `function` (via `run_sync`) and `async_function`.
- `haystack_tools(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> list[Any]`: Haystack `Tool`s for every registry tool exported to this target.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.langchain`

LangChain: registry tools as `StructuredTool`s, and LangChain tools imported as `ToolSpec`s.

- `INTEGRATION`: `LangChainIntegration` instance
- `LangChainIntegration()`: Exports `StructuredTool`s; the executor's approval port decides `confirm` tools.
- `import_langchain(registry: Registry, tools: Iterable[Any], *, prefix: str = '', **policy: Any) -> list[ToolSpec]`: Add LangChain `BaseTool`s to `registry` (all or nothing) and return their specs.
- `structured_tool(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> Any`: `spec` as a LangChain `StructuredTool` that runs through the executor.
- `structured_tools(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> list[Any]`: `structured_tool` for every registry tool exported to LangChain.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.langgraph`

LangGraph: tool nodes, `Send` tasks, reducers, interrupt approvals, flows, compression.

- `INTEGRATION`: `LangGraphIntegration` instance
- `LangGraphApproval(key: bytes | None = None) -> None`: An ApprovalPort that pauses the graph with `interrupt()`; a signed resume value decides.
- `LangGraphCompressor(policy: CompressionPolicy, *, pinned: Pinned | None = None, model_max_tokens: int | None = None) -> None`: Compresses LangChain messages before your node calls its model; the state is untouched.
- `LangGraphIntegration()`: Exports tool nodes and compiles flows; approvals pause the graph with `interrupt()`.
- `ToolNode(specs: Mapping[str, ToolSpec], runner: ToolRunner, messages_key: str, concurrency: int | None) -> None`: Runs tool calls as ToolMessages; `tools` are the definitions to bind to a model.
- `ToolTask(spec: ToolSpec, runner: ToolRunner, into: str) -> None`: A `Send` target: runs one tool with the `Send` argument and writes `{into: value}`.
- `compile_flow(flow: Flow[Any], *, executor: Executor | None = None, checkpoint_key: bytes | None = None) -> Any`: `flow` as a LangGraph `StateGraph`; compile it with a checkpointer to pause and resume.
- `fan_out(target: str, over: str | Callable[[Any], Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]]]) -> Callable[[Any], list[Any]]`: A conditional-edge path sending each item (a mapping) of `over` to node `target`.
- `langgraph_compressor(policy: CompressionPolicy, *, pinned: Pinned | None = None, model_max_tokens: int | None = None) -> LangGraphCompressor`: A compressor for `state["messages"]`: `await c(messages)` or `c.sync(messages)`.
- `one_use(node: Callable[..., Any]) -> Callable[..., Any]`: Your own LangGraph node, run as one task execution: each approval answer is used once.
- `reducer(rule: MergeRule) -> Any`: A LangGraph channel applying `rule` to all writes of a superstep: `Annotated[T, reducer(r)]`.
- `async run_compiled(app: Any, state: Any, config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> FlowResult[Any]`: Run a graph compiled from `compile_flow` until it is done, paused or denied.
- `tool_node(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None, messages_key: str = 'messages', concurrency: int | None = None) -> ToolNode`: A LangGraph node that runs the last AI message's tool calls through the executor.
- `tool_task(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None, into: str) -> ToolTask`: A node for `Send(node, args)`: runs `spec` with `args`, returns `{into: value}`.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.llamaindex`

LlamaIndex: registry tools as `FunctionTool`s, and the `llamaindex` compression format.

- `INTEGRATION`: `LlamaIndexIntegration` instance
- `LlamaIndexIntegration()`: Exports `FunctionTool`s; LlamaIndex has no call id at the tool boundary.
- `llamaindex_tool(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> FunctionTool`: A `FunctionTool` with `fn_schema=spec.args_model`; `acall` is async, `call` uses `run_sync`.
- `llamaindex_tools(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> list[FunctionTool]`: `llamaindex_tool` for every registry tool exported to `llamaindex`.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.mcp`

MCP: serve registry tools to any MCP client, and import tools from MCP servers.

- `APPROVAL_ID_META = 'agent-adapter/approval_id'`
- `CALL_ID_META = 'agent-adapter/call_id'`
- `ERROR_KIND_META = 'agent-adapter/error_kind'`
- `INTEGRATION`: `MCPIntegration` instance
- `MCPIntegration()`: Exports `mcp.types.Tool` definitions; `mcp_server` runs the calls.
- `MemoryTaskStore(*, max_entries: int = 100000, clock: Callable[[], float] = monotonic) -> None`: In-process `TaskStore`: shared by the servers of one process only.
- `MemoryTokenStorage() -> None`: Tokens and client registration for one server, in this process only; never logged.
- `RUN_ID_META = 'agent-adapter/run_id'`
- `RedisTaskStore(client_factory: Callable[[], Any], *, prefix: str = 'aa:mcp-task:') -> None`: `TaskStore` on Redis (`agent-adapter[redis]`), shared by every worker and host.
- `TASKS_EXTENSION = 'io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks'`
- `TASK_ID_META = 'agent-adapter/task_id'`
- `TaskOptions(threshold_s: float | None = 5.0, ttl_s: float = 3600.0, poll_interval_s: float = 2.0, approval_url: str | None = None, max_tasks: int = 10000, max_per_principal: int = 100, store: TaskStore | None = None) -> None`: How `mcp_server(tasks=...)` answers 2026-07-28 clients that accept tasks.
- `TaskStore` (protocol: delete, flag, flagged, get, put): Task states (written by the worker running the task) and signals (from any worker).
- `client_metadata_document(client_metadata_url: str, *, redirect_uris: Sequence[str], client_name: str = 'agent-adapter', scope: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]`: The JSON to publish at `client_metadata_url`; its `client_id` is that URL.
- `async import_mcp(registry: Registry, client: Client, *, prefix: str = '', names: Iterable[str] | None = None, send_ids: bool = False, **policy: Any) -> list[ToolSpec]`: Register the tools of an open `mcp.Client` (all of them, or the remote `names`).
- `mcp_client(target: Any, *, headers: Mapping[str, str] | None = None, auth: Auth | None = None, tasks: bool = False, task_wait_s: float = 30.0) -> Client`: An unopened `mcp.Client` for an http(s) URL (Streamable HTTP), a `StdioServerParameters`, an in-process `Server` / `MCPServer`, or a client transport.
- `mcp_server(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None, name: str = 'agent-adapter', version: str = '1.0.0', instructions: str | None = None, client_approval: bool = False, request_state_keys: Sequence[bytes | str] | None = None, principal: PrincipalHook | None = None, allow_anonymous: bool | None = None, approval_store: ApprovalStore | None = None, tasks: TaskOptions | bool = False) -> Server`: A lowlevel MCP `Server` listing and calling `registry.for_target("mcp")`.
- `mcp_tool(spec: ToolSpec) -> Tool`: The MCP tool definition for `spec`: schemas, wrapped output schema, annotations.
- `oauth_client(server_url: str, *, client_metadata_url: str, redirect_uri: str, redirect_handler: Callable[[str], Awaitable[None]], callback_handler: Callable[[], Awaitable[AuthorizationCodeResult]], storage: Any = None, client_name: str = 'agent-adapter', scope: str | None = None) -> OAuthClientProvider`: An `httpx2.Auth` for `mcp_client(server_url, auth=...)`: authorization code + PKCE.
- `output_schema_for(spec: ToolSpec) -> dict[str, Any] | None`: `outputSchema`: the result schema, wrapped under `result` unless it is an object.
- `streamable_http_app(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None, path: str = '/mcp', stateless: bool = True, json_response: bool = True, name: str = 'agent-adapter', version: str = '1.0.0', instructions: str | None = None, client_approval: bool = False, request_state_keys: Sequence[bytes | str] | None = None, principal: PrincipalHook | None = AUTHENTICATED, allow_anonymous: bool = False, approval_store: ApprovalStore | None = None, tasks: TaskOptions | bool = False, **http_options: Any) -> Any`: An ASGI (Starlette) app serving `mcp_server(registry, ...)` over Streamable HTTP at `path`.
- `tool_annotations(spec: ToolSpec) -> dict[str, bool]`: MCP `ToolAnnotations` fields (snake_case) from `effects`, `confirm` and `idempotent`.

- `QueryAuth(name: str, value: str) -> None`: A fixed query parameter, e.g.

### `agent_adapter.integrations.strands`

Strands Agents: each ToolSpec as an `AgentTool`; approval through a before-tool-call hook.

- `INTEGRATION`: `StrandsIntegration` instance
- `StrandsIntegration()`: Exports `AgentTool`s; `strands_approval_hook` asks an approval port before a call.
- `strands_approval_hook(port: ApprovalPort, registry: Registry) -> Any`: A `BeforeToolCallEvent` callback: asks `port` about `registry` tools whose rule says so.
- `strands_compress_middleware(policy: CompressionPolicy, *, pinned: Pinned | None = None, model_max_tokens: int | None = None) -> Callable[[Any], Awaitable[Any]]`: An Input handler: `agent.add_middleware(InvokeModelStage.Input, handler)`.
- `strands_tool(spec: ToolSpec, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> Any`: An `AgentTool` for `spec`; results are Strands tool results (`status` error or success).
- `strands_tools(registry: Registry, *, executor: ToolRunner | None = None) -> list[Any]`: `AgentTool`s for every registry tool exported to this target.
